Grammar: 了 Indicating a Change
了 (le) — particle indicating a change/new circumstance
祈使句 不要……了/别……了 Imperative Sentence
Grammar: "了" Indicating a Change
除了……以外，都/还/也…… Structure (Except For / Besides)
Grammar Note: 了 Indicating Occurrence or Completion
Grammar: Verb + 了 + modifier + Object (了 between verb and object; the object usually has a numeral-measure word, adjective or pronoun before it)
Grammar: 没 + Verb (+ Object) (negative form of 了; 了 is omitted)
了 (le) - used at the end of or in the middle of a sentence to indicate a change or a new circumstance (part., Lesson 5)

为了使学习者适应HSK的考试题型，教材的各级练习册设计的练习题型均与HSK考试题型吻合，从练习的顺序到练习的结构等都与考题试卷保持一致，练习的内容以本课的内容为主，目的是学习者学完教材就能适应HSK考试，不需额外熟悉考试形式。 (Wèile shǐ xuéxízhě shìyìng HSK de kǎoshì tíxíng, jiàocái de gè jí liànxí cè shèjì de liànxí tíxíng jūn yǔ HSK kǎoshì tíxíng wěnhé, cóng liànxí de shùnxù dào liànxí de jiégòu děng dōu yǔ kǎotí shìjuàn bǎochí yīzhì, liànxí de nèiróng yǐ běn kè de nèiróng wéi zhǔ, mùdì shì xuéxízhě xuéwán jiàocái jiù néng shìyìng HSK kǎoshì, bù xū éwài shúxī kǎoshì xíngshì.) - So that learners adapt to the HSK question types, the workbook exercises at every level match the HSK question types in order and structure, with content based mainly on the lesson, so learners can adapt to the HSK exam after finishing the textbook without extra familiarization with the exam format.
Grammar: 祈使句：不要……了；别……了 (The Imperative Sentence "不要……了/别……了") - Lesson 10 grammar point (listed in Contents)
Grammar: 动作的状态："要……了" "要……了" Indicating the State of an Action (Lesson 15, listed in syllabus)
Grammar: "都……了" The Structure "都……了" (Lesson 15, listed in syllabus)
Grammar: Negative of complement of result (没(有) + V + complement; 了 cannot end the sentence)
Grammar: Question with complement of result (add (了)没有 at the end of the sentence)
Grammar: 快要/快/就要/要……了 (expressing that an action or change is about to happen; structure to use in the group-work activity)
Grammar: V₁了……就V₂…… with two subjects (the second subject goes right before 就)
Grammar: S + V + 了 + Duration + O (duration of a completed action)
Grammar: S + V + 了 + Duration + O + 了 (duration of an action still going on)
Grammar: if the action is completed and realized, the object usually goes after 来/去 (哥哥买回来了一个西瓜)
Grammar: 除了……以外，都…… (all except: the rest share the same situation; 以外 can be omitted)
Grammar: 除了……以外，还/也…… (besides: adds others; subject goes at start or before 还/也)
